# Roohsites Appointment Booking

> Appointment booking plugin for WordPress, for salons, tutors, coaches and other service businesses. The free plugin (on WordPress.org) has unlimited staff and services. Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro ($79/year for 1 site, $149 for 5, $299 for unlimited; same price at renewal; 14-day free trial without a card) adds Razorpay (UPI), Stripe and PayPal payments or deposits with automatic refunds, email/SMS/WhatsApp reminders, two-way Google Calendar sync, a drag-and-drop admin calendar and a customer page to reschedule or cancel.
